purpose: Confirm capture-branch-expansion enrichment on an independent seed block while treating repeated deterministic trajectories as a primary structural constraint.

structuralUnits.deduplicationPolicy: Keep the first row for each trajectoryHash + eventPly key after deterministic sorting; report duplicate groups separately.

primaryEndpoint.name: trajectory-ply-deduplicated capture-branch-expansion enrichment
primaryEndpoint.candidateNumerator: Unique candidate trajectory-ply units classified as capture-branch-expansion
primaryEndpoint.candidateDenominator: All unique A-candidate trajectory-ply units in the primary population
primaryEndpoint.controlNumerator: Unique eligible control trajectory-ply units classified as capture-branch-expansion
primaryEndpoint.controlDenominator: All unique eligible control trajectory-ply units in the primary population
primaryEndpoint.effectMeasure: deduplicated candidate rate divided by deduplicated control rate

sampleSizeDesign.caveat: Poisson calculations use E-010 point estimates and are planning approximations, not inferential evidence. The availability counts are correlated, so the product is descriptive only.

secondaryEndpoints: Raw candidate-row endpoint using the E-010 decision unit

decisionRule.confirmed: All structural sample-availability and primary effect criteria pass.
decisionRule.notConfirmed: One or more criteria fail after successful corpus and integrity validation.
decisionRule.inconclusive: Corpus generation, schema/hash validation, trajectory mapping, or required output construction fails.

executionPolicy.approvalRequirement: A separate explicit instruction is required before generating the 1000-game formal corpus.

changePolicy: Any change after this commit must create a new preregistration version. E-010 or E-011 results may not be used to relax this file after E-017 data generation starts.
